title: I watched Harakiri and it was great!

commenti.body:
A bit later (in color) the movie *Ran* is amazing. It's a medieval epic with a Shakespearean story made by Kurosawa. Top level.

I also enjoyed *High and Low* from Kurosawa, which is set in the 60s and follows a police investigation (if you want something that isn't a period drama).

The subtext of the film is obvious but reinforced via its wonderful performances and cinematography, which reinforces the themes through its shot composition. The whole "human condition trilogy" using feudal Japan as the allegorical backdrop is a great technical achievement.
